states.VERIFIED: An Orbis release was tested on physical hardware of this group and a receipt is recorded in tests/hardware/receipts/. (None yet.)
states.UPSTREAM_REPORTED: An upstream project recorded a pass on at least one console of this group with a different stack. Plausible, not proven for Orbis.
states.UNVERIFIED: No evidence either way for this group.
states.UNSUPPORTED: Known not to work, or not exposed by the kernel/platform.
states.BLOCKED: Cannot work until a named prerequisite is solved.
states.PASSED_ON_THIS_DEVICE: Runtime overlay: an Orbis check passed on this console during this boot.
states.FAILED: Runtime overlay: an Orbis check failed on this console during this boot.

groups.fat-belize: late CUH-12xx, Belize southbridge, Liverpool GPU

slim-baikal.evidence: 7.2.11 boot observed on one Slim Baikal B1

capabilities.title: External USB SSD root filesystem
capabilities.notes: UAS-capable adapter strongly preferred; do not root through a USB hub.

capabilities.title: Root on internal HDD image (linux.img)
capabilities.notes: Orbis v1 does not install to the internal drive; it never writes Sony partitions.

slim-baikal.evidence: Baikal internal SATA is experimental/read-mostly upstream

capabilities.title: 1080p60 HDMI console + desktop modeset
capabilities.notes: Requires the ps4_bridge ICC-delay fix (present in feeRnt 6.15.4 crashnt-4.7) and avoiding the 120 Hz mode (Orbis kernel patch 0001).

fat-aeolia.evidence: CUH-12xx MN864729: modeset + Hyprland KMS after moving to 6.15.4-crashnt-4.7

capabilities.title: Monitor hotplug / EDID
capabilities.notes: ps4_bridge advertises hard-coded modes; EDID is empty on tested hardware. Tutorial: hotplug not supported on 6.18+.

slim-baikal.evidence: cube/depth hangs on 26.2.5 dev2/dev3; dev5 passed 120 cube frames on one console; system adoption rolled back

capabilities.title: Vulkan LLM inference (gate)
capabilities.notes: Upstream: all 25 layers offloaded with exact short-prompt output; a longer prompt faulted during prefill and recovery failed (carlosgeorges.com/notes/ps4-linux.html). Root cause unknown.

slim-baikal.evidence: experimental 1080p30 runtime; default boot falls back to software
native psx0 driver on 7.2 (experimental; no unload/reset)

pro-baikal.evidence: Ethernet may not work on Pro Baikal

capabilities.title: Built-in Wi-Fi
capabilities.notes: Chipset varies: Marvell 88W8797/8897 (Torus) or MediaTek MT7668. Firmware must be operator-supplied (licensing).

capabilities.title: DualShock 4 (USB/BT)
capabilities.notes: Kernel has HID_SONY/HID_PLAYSTATION. BT pairing is not persistent across payload launches.

capabilities.title: DS4 Bluetooth pairing survives reboot
capabilities.notes: Pairing keys live in the PS4 OS; must re-pair every boot (DionKill tutorial issues.md).

capabilities.title: Fan speed reading / control
capabilities.notes: No fan hwmon is exposed by the kernels inspected. Fan is managed by the southbridge firmware.

capabilities.title: Suspend / hibernate
capabilities.notes: CONFIG_SUSPEND and CONFIG_HIBERNATION are unset in the PS4 kernels inspected. Orbis masks sleep targets.

capabilities.title: Reboot directly back into Linux
capabilities.notes: Reboot returns to the PS4 system software; operator relaunches the payload.

capabilities.title: Linux-to-Linux kexec relaunch
capabilities.notes: Reported working with custom handoff patches (carlosgeorges.com); not present in Orbis kernels. Cannot change VRAM.

capabilities.title: Change VRAM carve-out without reboot
capabilities.notes: Carve-out is set by the loader (vram.txt) before Linux starts (linux-psx docs/PS4-DYNAMIC-MEMORY.md).
